topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Hey there! I just heard about your plans to put up a fence. I was thinking, fences can really make a space feel more private, can't they? I was wondering if you thought about what kind of fence you want. Wood, metal, something with a nice, natural feel? And hey, if you decide on the type, maybe we could chat about the layout. I know our yard has a few interesting angles that might be tricky. totally get that fences are a big decision, and I just want to make sure everything goes smoothly. Let me know if you need a second opinion or just someone to bounce ideas off. I'm all ears!
